notes: DSH Android 0.5.0: Settings & home refresh (first UI-refresh batch). Settings gets a live connection hero (host, active route, latency, routes, last sync, Hosts/Connection shortcuts), search-as-you-type across groups, a compact host-actions card and a collapsed Advanced section (diagnostics, storage, build). Home gets a route/latency/sync strip and quick filters (All/Working/Needs input/Idle + Filters). All previous controls unchanged.
